source.author_current_server: 403; retrieved via third party; bytes match historical metadata
source.preprotocol_exposure: Downloaded public bytes; one arbitrary dataset viewer record parsed in memory for schema only. No full original JSON parsing, cohort selection, ranking or scoring before protocol.

license.each_document_attribution: outside-project sidecar doc_id/title/canonical Wikipedia URL/revision unknown; source receipt binds sidecar SHA
license.per_article_revision_and_contributors: unknown; no claim of complete legal rights determination
license.distribution: Only reviewed allowlisted aggregate published; raw source, passages, queries, qrels and original reports remain local. Preserve source attribution and limitations.

preparation.parse: strict UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate keys/nonfinite numbers; full public source parse necessarily loads final candidates and labels, no blindness claim
preparation.group_representative: minimum raw _id by UTF-8 bytes independent of answers, contexts, support labels and rankings
preparation.query_id: q-<raw _id>, valid native identifier <=80 ASCII chars
preparation.document_id: d-<sha256 of UTF8 canonical JSON [exact title,ordered sentence list]>, valid native ID <=80
preparation.text_join: join exact ordered source sentences with one ASCII space
preparation.corpus: all contexts of all selected questions independently of supporting labels; deduplicate exact title/sentence tuple, globally reject same title with differing tuple; never filter selected questions on outcomes
preparation.support_qrels: all distinct supporting_facts titles in that query mapped to exact context docs, strict valid sentence integer/coordinate, grade 1, at least one; never filter missing or invalid, stop
preparation.sidecar: per selected corpus doc_id, original title, canonical percent-encoded English Wikipedia article URL, source dump date, revision unknown; no query ID/mapping/label; source_receipt SHA binds sidecar SHA
preparation.private: final qids/questions/qrels and selection mapping only in private study files; source raw and internal report outside Git; shared corpus necessarily contains final-candidate documents
preparation.bounds: native existing staged corpus<=10000 rows, all development assets<=11800000 bytes, license<=65536 bytes, source packet/result and private holdout existing limits; cap violation stops
preparation.failure: malformed input, any duplicate qid, selected global title conflict, missing/invalid support coordinates, hash collision, incomplete source, cap violation or attribution sidecar failure stops and preserves evidence; no skip, seed change or score-based reselection

runtime.source_pin: clean exact published commit containing protocol and driver; preserve source core identity; no mutable old pin

selection.question: Does fixed validation support-document retrieval show TFIDF vs BM25 recall improvement without MRR loss and with positive recall delta after each single-query removal?
selection.operators: strict original saved values, no epsilon rounding for predicate
selection.scientific_meaning: annotated supporting documents only; incomplete annotations do not imply non-relevance; not answer correctness or multi-hop reasoning
selection.rationale: Chosen before Hotpot full JSON parsing or scoring but informed by previously observed S060 sensitivity; not blind or unbiased discovery

budget.lineage: s065-hotpot-support-v1 independent new topic; old case and global protected budgets unchanged

policy.not_met_final: BM25 single arm, selected-vs-baseline zero is structural and does not measure TFIDF on final

report.native_report: internal only; input.json/report.json include development source packet and may contain raw text/base64
report.public: only independently reviewed allowlist of aggregate metrics, identities, counts, attribution, budget and limits; no passages, queries, query IDs/hashes, qrels, per-query rows, private packets or report input
report.claims: no generalization, significance, causation, model research, QA, multi-hop or sealed inference

execution.publication: protocol and driver/test source committed and independently reviewed before parsing original JSON; prepare-only creates no research project or native action
execution.claim: atomic exclusive cooperative study claim in shared source-pins/.study-claims; preserve claim and original workspace permanently; do not imply OS/global synchronization
execution.durability: write original exact bodies, input/source/code/plan/owner, cumulative budget and absolute deadline before dispatch; no overwrite or reselection
execution.resume: same original request IDs, same source-pinned workspace and original absolute deadline; unknown/partial/missing DB/marker fails closed without new dispatch, new IDs, project or directory
stages: v3 hypothesis with both known branches audit
independent audit and same-ID readonly replay
execution.resource_or_schema_failure: stop and preserve evidence; do not adjust cohort, budget or thresholds after results
